parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: DataId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data that you want to export.

> 

*   Multiple export methods are supported.

*   If you want to export a single configuration, you must leave the Ids parameter empty and specify the DataID and Group parameters.

parameters.name: DataIds
parameters.description: The configuration group name and the ID of the configuration that you want to export. Separate multiple configurations with comma (,).

parameters.name: Group
parameters.description: The name of the configuration group.

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description:
The ID of the primary key of a configuration item.

>  - Multiple export methods are supported. You must specify this parameter if you want to export multiple configurations. - You can obtain the value of this parameter by calling the ListNacosConfigs operation. - If you specify this parameter, multiple configurations are exported. The DataId and Group parameters are invalid.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse export-nacos-config --instance-id mse-cn-2r42ddc0000 --namespace-id ae77c258-4d4f-478f-baaa-084aee00000 --ids 1709,1710 --data-id demo-develop --group COMMON_GROUP --app-name gateway-openapi --data-ids testDataId1+testGroup1,testDataId2+testGroup --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse ExportNacosConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Group COMMON_GROUP --DataId 'demo-develop' --DataIds 'testDataId1+testGroup1,testDataId2+testGroup' --InstanceId 'mse-cn-2r42ddc0000' --Ids '1709,1710' --AcceptLanguage zh --NamespaceId 'ae77c258-4d4f-478f-baaa-084aee00000' --AppName 'gateway-openapi'
